- I own a complete Pink monopoly (St. Charles, Tennessee, Illinois) with $1,197 cash
- OpenAI GPT mini is at $24 (critical state, near elimination)
- Gemini 3.5 Flash is at $809 with strong Dark Blue but in jail
- No buildable properties are listed in post-turn actions (building happens on main turn)

**Strategic Decision:**
There's nothing beneficial for me to do in this post-turn phase:
- Mortgaging Pink would destroy my winning engine
- Trading is unnecessary—I have my core asset (complete Pink monopoly)
- My cash position is strong for the execution phase

OpenAI will likely bankrupt naturally on their next tiles. I need to preserve my Pink monopoly intact and move to the main turn where I can roll dice and immediately start building 4-5 houses to generate exponential rent pressure.
